thread:
Aisha Patel: quick handoff for Cobalt Health — signed MSA yesterday. ACV $85k ARR. HIPAA scope confirmed, they want SSO (Okta) + on-prem log export to their SIEM. Go-live target 2026-04-15, initial prod traffic low but will ramp after Q2..sales notes: tight timeline, legal asked for data residency controls.

Ben Gomez: got it, assigning onboarding lead here. I'll run kickoff and own the playbook. Need: SSO metadata, sample log schema, and preferred support window. I'll propose weekly 30m check-ins until go-live.

Liz Chen: adding to support queue and will create a dedicated incident/runbook channel. Need confirmation on alerting thresholds and whether they want an on-call escalation. @Ben could you confirm?

Samir Rao: tagging from product/eng — heads up on on-prem log sink. We may need to ship a small collector (lightweight) or provide secure S3 transfer. If they want HSM/KMS integration for keys let me know.

Aisha Patel: answers: Okta SAML, sample log fields attached in the contract (see link). Support window 8am-6pm PST preferred. They asked for KMS integration later in Q3, not required for go-live.

Ben Gomez: scheduling kickoff for Mon 2026-03-30 10am PT. Invite going out now. Action items: (1) Ben — create onboarding checklist + runbook by 2026-03-27, (2) Liz — support channel + initial playbook by 2026-03-28, (3) Samir — evaluate sink options and share recommended path by 2026-03-29, (4) Aisha — intro email with Okta admin details and legal contact.

Liz Chen: noted. I'll include escalation steps and sample runbook snippet. Also will add a standard "access revocation" step for HIPAA.

Samir Rao: quick note on collector approach — recommend secure S3 push with client-side encryption. If they insist on direct syslog we can supply a Docker collector. Example config they should send: ```json
{
  "s3_bucket": "cobalt-logs-prod",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:...:key/...",
  "log_format": "json_v2"
}
```

Aisha Patel: sounds good. I'll attach the Okta metadata and sample contract extract to the kickoff invite. One risk to flag: customer has an internal security review window that can delay go-live by 2–3 weeks if any encryption questions arise. Put renewal/expansion notes in Gainsight (they're >50% likely to expand after Q4).

Ben Gomez: ack, adding renewal risk and expansion note to CS record. Also setting a "security review" milestone in the onboarding checklist.

OnboardBot: Reminder — kickoff scheduled Mon 2026-03-30 10:00 PT. Tasks due: onboarding checklist (Ben), support runbook (Liz), sink proposal (Samir).

Liz Chen: :thumbsup: I'll draft the runbook and ping infra for the escalation rota.

Ben Gomez: thanks team — I'll close the handoff once kickoff happens and post an updated progress note here.

Aisha Patel: appreciate it — leaving contact open if legal needs anything before kickoff.
